title: Satin sews an H section by section, as PE-DESIGN orders them
description: An H sewn in satin at 0°, density 3, without under sewing, must be sewn in sections as PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews it: a first row along the start point's edge, then the sections from the far end of the rows up (bottom right, bottom left, crossbar, top right), each leg from its tip, and last the section with the start point, ending there; running stitches inside the H between sections, no trim or jump.

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference compat/reference/stitches/satin-sections-h.pes (under sewing off, 2026-10-27): 236 stitches; after the tie-in and a first row along y = 0 at the start point (0, 0), travel to the bottom-right tip, bottom-right leg up to the crossbar, travel, bottom-left leg up, the crossbar from its bottom edge up, travel to the top-right tip, top-right leg down, travel, top-left leg up to the start point, end lock. region-travel-u-satin's U is sewn by the same rule.

references.make: On a 100 x 100 mm Design Page draw the closed polygon (0,0) (10,0) (10,12) (20,12) (20,0) (30,0) (30,30) (20,30) (20,18) (10,18) (10,30) (0,30) mm (an H). Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction 0°, Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: OpenStitch travels inside the H with running stitches (audit item 3). PE-DESIGN's file has one trim and one jump inside, both in its opening move: a 10 mm jump along the start edge (the same opening row is an ordinary stitch in region-travel-u-satin), so this is not compared with the reference.

OpenStitch travels inside the H with running stitches (audit item 3). PE-DESIGN's file has one trim and one jump inside, both in its opening move: a 10 mm jump along the start edge (the same opening row is an ordinary stitch in region-travel-u-satin), so this is not compared with the reference.
Travel stays inside the H (audit item 3).
